headline: Monsters Hold the Top Spot as Foxes and Hurricanes Climb the Board
lede: The Pecking Order shuffles hard this week. Monsters keep the top spot on a 76.7% all-play mark. Foxes jump 17 spots after a 5-1 run and a 195.0 PPG stretch.

rankings.blurb: Monsters sit at #1 with a 76.7% all-play mark, the best in the top 25. Per a league source, nobody in the league is consistently beating them.
Foxes are up 17 spots to #2 on a 5-game winning streak. Their 195.0 PPG over the last three weeks is the number to watch.
Hurricanes climb to #3 after a 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak. Word around the league is they are heating up.
BearCats rocket up 11 spots to #4 with a 9-game winning streak. A 6-0 mark over the last three weeks says this run is no accident.
Nemesis slip two spots to #5 despite a 71.8% all-play mark. Their 168.3 PPG over the last three weeks has cooled off.
Jockeys move up two to #6 on a 6-game winning streak and a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks. I'm told the front office is pleased.
Hoosiers climb six spots to #7 on a 3-game winning streak. Their 71.4% all-play mark is quietly one of the strongest in the league.
Chickens drop four spots to #8 even though they are riding a 17-game winning streak. Per a league source, the streak is the longest active one in the league.
Waves jump 13 spots to #9 on a 182.8 PPG stretch over the last three weeks. Keep an eye on them as the schedule turns.
Demons slip one spot to #10 with a 2-game winning streak. Their 4-2 mark over the last three weeks is solid but not spectacular.
Barracudas tumble nine spots to #11 on a 2-game losing streak. A 2-4 mark over the last three weeks is a problem they need to fix now.
Crushers rocket up 18 spots to #12 with an 8-game winning streak and a 6-0 run over the last three weeks. Sources say they are the league's hottest team.
Roos climb 10 spots to #13 with a 2-game winning streak. A 4-2 mark over the last three weeks has them in the mix.
Chargers move up 11 spots to #14 on a 5-1 run over the last three weeks. Their 61.4% all-play mark backs up the climb.
Rafters rocket up 20 spots to #15 on a 3-game winning streak. Their 170.3 PPG over the last three weeks is the big reason.
Monkeys drop five spots to #16 after a 3-3 stretch over the last three weeks. Their 154.1 PPG over that span is too low to hold position.
Tombstones fall 12 spots to #17 despite a 71.6% all-play mark. Their 144.0 PPG over the last three weeks is the problem.
Yetis slip four spots to #18 with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks. Their 150.9 PPG over that span keeps them in the middle of the pack.
Razerbacks drop nine spots to #19 even with a 3-game winning streak. Their 142.5 PPG over the last three weeks is the weak spot.
Lumberjacks jump 12 spots to #20 on a 176.4 PPG stretch over the last three weeks. Their 50.7% all-play mark is the one flag to watch.
SaltyDogs fall nine spots to #21 despite a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks. Their 57.3% all-play mark is the concern.
Wolverines climb nine spots to #22 on a 5-1 run over the last three weeks. Their 167.9 PPG over that span is the engine.
Dawgs move up four spots to #23 with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks. Their 61.8% all-play mark is steady.
KitKats drop six spots to #24 on a 2-game losing streak. Their 152.9 PPG over the last three weeks is not enough to stop the slide.
Cellmates slip one spot to #25 after a 3-3 stretch. Their 145.4 PPG over the last three weeks is the number that hurts.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Foxes dropped 225.13 this week, the highest score in the league. Per a league source, that number will be remembered.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Bears left 73.58 points on the bench after scoring 105.54 when they could have hit 179.12. That is a brutal lineup mistake.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Chickens have won 17 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. Nobody has a hotter run right now.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Chupacabras have dropped 16 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. Their owner has some hard calls ahead.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 11 brings the highest-ranked clash on the slate: #2 Foxes at #18 Yetis. Keep an eye on that one.
